text:
Lena Morales: Heads-up: we've got a pattern of cert-rotator failures in eu-west-1 and I'm seeing increased proxy->model-serving TLS timeouts. Errors point to failed keystore writes.
Diego Alvarez: saw the alert from uptime. timeframe ~01:12-01:30 UTC. any KMS denies in logs?
Samira Khan: checking. audit-bot: list IAM binds changed for keystore roles in eu-west-1 in the last 3 hours.
audit-bot: @Samira Khan: 2 PRs merged touching keystore/rotator roles between 00:50-01:05 UTC: PR#4896 (role narrowing), PR#4902 (policy templating). Details attached.
Lena Morales: sample proxy log: ```WARN proxy: handshake timeout: upstream unwrap error: AccessDenied: User: arn:aws:iam::123456:role/keystore-rotator-eu not authorized to perform: kms:Encrypt on resource arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456:key/zzzz-1111```
Evan Park: interesting — PR#4896 was intended to remove unused kms:GenerateDataKey* perms and scope keys by tag, but looks like the rotator needs kms:Encrypt to persist wrapped blobs.
Nina Roberts: suspicion: earlier TLS hardening patch (force TLS1.3, drop RSA ciphers) was applied to front-proxies in eu-west-1 last night. Could this be a timing coincidence where rotator retried after key rotation but couldn't write, so proxies rejected stale certs?
Diego Alvarez: infra-oncall: can you confirm rotator execution times and whether any certs were left in partial state?
infra-oncall: cert-rotator job started 01:05 UTC and attempted writes for 12 pods; 9 succeeded, 3 failed with "kms:Encrypt AccessDenied". Rotator retries then gave up; those replicas continued serving with short-lived certs leading to client handshake fallbacks and timeouts.
Samira Khan: mitigation plan: 1) restore kms:Encrypt for keystore-rotator role in eu-west-1 only; 2) re-run rotator for failed pods; 3) add CI check to flag PRs that remove kms:Encrypt from roles referenced by rotator.
Lena Morales: agreed. also add audit extraction for compliance: export all KMS Deny/Allow entries for the affected key for the 1hr window. audit-bot?
audit-bot: exporting 34 KMS events for key arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456:key/zzzz-1111 between 00:55-01:30 UTC. CSV bucket link: s3://redwood-audit-exports/eu-keystore-1739999999.csv
Evan Park: I'm applying an emergency policy patch scoped to role arn:aws:iam::123456:role/keystore-rotator-eu at 01:22 UTC and will monitor. deploy-bot: apply policy keystore-rotator-encrypt-temp v0.1.1
deploy-bot: policy applied to keystore-rotator-eu in eu-west-1. running smoke tests.
deploy-bot: smoke: 6/6 proxies in eu-west-1 passed mTLS connect test against model-serving within 30s.
Lena Morales: after policy patch, re-run rotator: `kubectl -n infra rollout restart deployment/cert-rotator-eu` then tail logs.
Samira Khan: rotator re-run completed at 01:40 UTC, previously failed pods reissued certs and persisted keys. handshake error rate dropped from 7.4% -> 0.5% in 10m window.
Diego Alvarez: can we confirm no audit gaps? any missing KMS events during the denied window?
audit-bot: all deny events recorded. note: the policy authoring PR#4896 omitted a KMS checklist item. tagging author: @Nina Roberts.
Nina Roberts: that's on me, I'll own the remediation PR to add the KMS checklist and a CI lint rule that requires a keystore-usage matrix when modifying keystore-scoped roles.
Evan Park: also let's add a non-destructive CI smoke: after IAM PRs that affect keystore roles, spin up a canary pod with the role and attempt a `kms:GenerateDataKey` + `kms:Encrypt` roundtrip against the target key in the PR's region. Fail PR if smoke fails.
Lena Morales: long-term actions: (A) Centralize keystore role templates across regions to avoid copy-paste errors; (B) update rotation playbook to retry writes with exponential backoff and surface partial-rotation metrics; (C) add a monitoring alert for "keystore write failures" distinct from generic TLS handshake errors.
Samira Khan: drafting incident note and timeline. will include PR diffs, audit export link, and remediation commits. incident doc: https://docs.redwood/incidents/keystore-encrypt-euw-1739999999
Nina Roberts: I'll open PR to revert the templating change that removed encrypt and add lint + checklist: https://git.redwood/iam/changes/4915
Evan Park: follow-up: ensure the TLS hardening rollout didn't have an implicit dependency on rotation timing. but current hypothesis is permissions mismatch caused partial rotations which combined with strict TLS rules amplified client timeouts.
Lena Morales: thanks all. if anyone sees residual mTLS rejects after 02:00 UTC please ping this thread. otherwise we'll mark mitigated and keep the postmortem open for the action items. :white_check_mark:
